title: GridSim v1 asset-bindings.json
description: The rules binding generator types to asset classes, one record each. Optional file; requires asset-classes.json. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

assetBinding.title: Asset binding
assetBinding.description: A binding rule (v1 AssetBindingDto): generators whose type matches get the class. Absent: both empty.
